summary: Datavault AI Inc. filed an 8-K on Aug 17, 2026, announcing an Arrangement Agreement to acquire all outstanding shares of CyberCatch Holdings, Inc. via a British Columbia plan of arrangement. Consideration: US$3.22 per share in cash; options cancelled for cash spread; warrants cancelled for no consideration. Subject to court and securityholder approval, plus regulatory conditions. Datavault also agreed to provide a secured bridge loan to CyberCatch within seven days. The transaction resembles a tender offer under US practice. What to watch: court hearing dates, shareholder vote timing, and regulatory clearance as key milestones for deal completion.
